text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [Digivolve] [Koji Minamoto] w/5 [Hybrid] trait cards under: Cost 5

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
[When Digivolving] [End of Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] By placing 1 Digimon card from this Digimon's digivolution cards as the bottom security card, delete all of your opponent's Digimon with the same level as the placed card.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon attack, by adding your top security card to the hand, this Digimon unsuspends.

extracted.name: MagnaGarurumon

qa.question: Can I use this card's digivolution requirement to digivolve for a cost of 5 even when my [Koji Minamoto] has more than 5 [Hybrid] trait cards under it?
Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon attacks?

qa.answer:
No. Digivolve from the Tamer as such, and do not treat it as if it is a digivolving Digimon. "When digivolving" effects and "when a Digimon digivolves" effects don't trigger.
Additionally, if a "Digimon can't digivolve" effect has activated, you can still digivolve from a Tamer with this digivolve requirement.
qa.question: Does the digivolution requirement that this card digivolve from a Tamer mean the Tamer that becomes a digivolution card is treated as if it is a Digimon when digivolving?

qa.answer:
Yes, you do.
A digivolution bonus draw is performed for any kind of digivolution.
qa.question: Do I perform a digivolution bonus draw even if I digivolve from a Tamer?

qa.answer:
No, it can't.
A card cannot attack on the turn it is played, even if it digivolves from a card placed on the field. It can only attack if it was not played that turn.
qa.question: If this card digivolves from a Tamer that was played this turn, can it attack this turn?

qa.answer:
Yes, it is.
If the Digimon leaves the field, that Tamer is trashed like normal digivolution cards.
qa.question: Is a Tamer card placed under a Digimon considered a digivolution card?
